name: Litigation
shortDescription: Comprehensive dispute resolution across all courts and tribunals in India.
description: Our dedicated dispute resolution team represents clients in litigation, arbitration (international & domestic), conciliation and mediation proceedings pertaining to civil, commercial, debt recovery, company and insolvency, real estate, criminal litigation including white collar crimes, constitutional and administrative law before the Supreme Court of India, State High Courts, District Courts, and various tribunals.

faqs.question: What courts do you practice in?
faqs.answer: We represent clients before the Supreme Court of India, State High Courts, District Courts, Consumer Protection fora, Competition Commission, and various tribunals including NCLT, ITAT, DRT, NGT, and Labour Courts.

faqs.question: Do you handle arbitration matters?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have extensive experience in both domestic and international arbitration, including filing petitions under Sections 9, 11, 14, 15, 34 and 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act.

name: Corporate & Commercial
shortDescription: End-to-end corporate legal services for businesses of all sizes.
description: Our corporate team is well versed in legal aspects of subsidiaries & joint ventures, collaborations, structuring of investment routes, inbound and outbound investments, restructuring, transactional due diligence, franchising, technology transfers & licensing, corporate governance, CSR initiatives, statutory compliances and allied services.

faqs.question: What are the compliance requirements for a new company?
faqs.answer: New companies must comply with various statutory requirements including obtaining a PAN/TAN, GST registration, ongoing ROC filings (Annual Returns, Financial Statements), and maintaining statutory registers. We assist with all initial and ongoing compliance.

faqs.question: How can you help with contract negotiations?
faqs.answer: We review, draft, and negotiate commercial contracts to ensure your interests are protected. We identify potential risks in clauses related to indemnity, enhance liability protection, and ensure clear termination rights.

name: Mergers & Acquisitions
shortDescription: Strategic M&A counsel for transformative transactions.
description: Our M&A team advises on merger & amalgamation, demerger, reconstruction, acquisitions & divestments of assets and businesses, leveraged buy-outs, distressed transactions and restructuring, buy-back of securities and reduction of capital. We work closely with in-house counsels, accounting firms and investment banks.

faqs.question: How long does the M&A process typically take?
faqs.answer: The timeline varies significantly based on complexity, but typically ranges from 4-6 months. This includes preliminary negotiations, due diligence (4-6 weeks), drafting definitive agreements, and obtaining regulatory approvals (NCLT, CCI, etc.).

faqs.question: What is the importance of due diligence?
faqs.answer: Due diligence is critical to identify potential legal, financial, and operational risks before finalizing a transaction. It helps in correct valuation and structuring of the deal to mitigate identified risks.

name: Intellectual Property
shortDescription: Comprehensive IP protection, prosecution and enforcement.
description: We have notable experience in IP-based transactional, regulatory and litigation matters including protection and enforcement of IP rights, negotiating contractual arrangements, joint ownership and assignments. We advise on prosecution and registration of trademark, patent, copyright and design, conduct IP audits and due diligence, and handle enforcement litigation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between specific IP rights?
faqs.answer: A Trademark protects your brand name and logo. Copyright protects original creative works like software, books, and art. Patents protect new inventions and processes. Designs protect the aesthetic appearance of a product.

faqs.question: How do I enforce my IP rights against infringement?
faqs.answer: Enforcement can involve sending Cease & Desist notices, filing civil suits for injunctions and damages, or initiating criminal action in certain cases. We assist in devising the most effective enforcement strategy.

name: Real Estate
shortDescription: Complete real estate legal solutions for developers and investors.
description: We advise and assist developers, investors and owners on legal and regulatory issues regarding Indian property laws covering transfer, sale, stamping & registration of property, land revenue and tenancy laws. We conduct due diligence and handle all transactional documentation.

faqs.question: What due diligence is required before buying property?
faqs.answer: It is essential to verify the title chain for at least 30 years, check for encumbrances (mortgages, liens), verify land use permissions (CLU), and ensure compliance with RERA and local municipal bylaws.

faqs.question: How does RERA protect property buyers?
faqs.answer: RERA mandates transparency in project details, ensures deposits are kept in separate accounts, enforces strict delivery timelines, and provides a specialized forum for quick dispute resolution against builders.

name: Banking & Finance
shortDescription: Comprehensive banking and finance legal services.
description: Our practice in the banking and finance sector covers loans, restructuring, external commercial borrowings, asset securitization, acquisition & leverage finance, structured finance, asset finance, project finance and related regulatory issues including risk management.

name: Insolvency & Bankruptcy
shortDescription: Expert guidance through insolvency and restructuring processes.
description: Our insolvency & bankruptcy team advises financial creditors, operational creditors, corporate debtors and insolvency professionals on all aspects of the insolvency, liquidation and restructuring processes under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

name: Employment & Labour
shortDescription: Comprehensive employment law and HR compliance services.
description: Our employment and labour law practice focuses on labour law compliances, drafting and reviewing employment agreements, policies, termination procedures, non-compete agreements, POSH compliance, and handling employee misconduct inquiries.

faqs.question: Is POSH compliance mandatory for all companies?
faqs.answer: Yes, any workplace with 10 or more employees must constitute an Internal Committee (IC) under the POSH Act. Even smaller organizations have specific compliance obligations to ensure a safe workplace.

faqs.question: Are non-compete agreements enforceable in India?
faqs.answer: Generally, non-compete agreements extending beyond the term of employment are considered void under Section 27 of the Contract Act. However, confidentiality and non-solicitation clauses are usually enforceable to protect trade secrets.

name: Taxation
shortDescription: Direct and indirect taxation advisory and compliance.
description: We advise clients on both direct and indirect taxation issues, structuring complex transactions and business models, cross-border and domestic transactions, India entry and exit strategies, permanent establishment and DTAA issues, and transfer pricing.

name: Competition / Anti-Trust
shortDescription: Competition law compliance and representation.
description: We specialize in all aspects of Indian competition law including concession arrangements, cartels, anti-competitive agreements, abuse of dominant position, representations before the Competition Commission of India and Competition Appellate Tribunal.

name: Data Protection & Privacy
shortDescription: Navigating India's data privacy and cyber security landscape.
description: We provide expert legal services in navigating the robust Indian legal framework dealing with data privacy and protection. We advise on evolving legal, technological and business issues relating to cyber security, data collection & protection and privacy.

name: Environment Law
shortDescription: Environmental compliance and regulatory advisory.
description: We assist clients on compliances and liabilities under environment legislations including the Environment Protection Act, 1986 and substantive areas of environment laws. We conduct environmental audits and environmental impact assessments.

name: Energy, Power & Infrastructure
shortDescription: End-to-end services for energy and infrastructure projects.
description: We render end-to-end services in bidding, project development, financing, M&A, conducting due diligence and drafting power purchase agreements, EPC contracts, O&M contracts, state support agreements, and fuel supply contracts.

name: Food & Beverage
shortDescription: Regulatory compliance for F&B industry.
description: We have expertise in advising on regulatory matters and legislations impacting the Food & Beverage industry including product labeling, packaging, permissibility of ingredients, weights & measures, FSSAI approvals and compliance with food safety laws.

name: Hospitality, Tourism & Retail
shortDescription: Integrated legal services for hospitality and retail sectors.
description: We provide integrated financing, real estate, tax, corporate, and intellectual property services including sale and acquisition, property due diligence, documentation, financing, contracts and franchises, M&A, and dispute resolution.

name: Start-ups
shortDescription: Supporting emerging businesses and entrepreneurs.
description: We advise, guide and assist the startup ecosystem by engaging with governmental bodies, incubators and accelerators to support emerging businesses and budding entrepreneurs covering the entire spectrum of new businesses and managing their legal and compliance issues.

name: Admiralty & Maritime

description: We draft and facilitate negotiations of ship building contracts, vessel acquisition or lease. We advise on pollution liabilities, UNCLOS and other International Conventions, and issues arising from bill of lading, charter-parties, cargo liens and vessel arrest.

name: Anti-Corruption & Compliance
shortDescription: Anti-bribery compliance and internal investigations.
description: We advise clients on Indian anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws as well as implications of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and U.K. Bribery Act. We specialize in both preventive and responsive approaches including internal investigations.

name: Drones / Unmanned Aircrafts

description: We assist clients in the registration process and advise on the evolving legal, regulatory and compliance issues with regard to drones and unmanned aircrafts in India under the Drone Rules, 2021 and Certification Scheme for UAS.

name: E-commerce
shortDescription: Legal support for e-commerce and FinTech businesses.
description: We cater to the legal, transactional and regulatory needs in the e-commerce and retail sectors covering the corporate and operational sides of the business including FinTech.

name: Estate Planning, Trusts & Wills
shortDescription: Private client services for wealth succession.
description: We specialize in private client areas such as trusts, estate planning, inheritance and succession, taxation, Hindu Undivided Family (HUF), wills and other testamentary instruments, obtaining probates and handling court-related dispute resolution.

name: Pharmaceutical & Life Sciences
shortDescription: Regulatory compliance for pharma and healthcare.
description: We advise on regulatory issues and compliances related to clinical trials, research and development, marketing, manufacturing and distribution, medical devices and stem cell research in India.

name: Media & Entertainment
shortDescription: Legal services for media, entertainment and sports.
description: We specialize in regulatory, technological, legal and tax issues in the industry and advise clients on broadcasting, publication, intellectual property, online gaming laws, entertainment laws, sports laws and ancillary matters.

name: Technology & Telecommunications

name: Education

description: We advise educational institutions, non-profit organizations and charitable foundations on legal and regulatory aspects with respect to UGC, AICTE pertaining to Indian education sector. We assist in structuring entry options for foreign universities.

name: Insurance
shortDescription: Insurance regulatory and transactional advisory.
description: We advise insurers, reinsurers, intermediaries, investors, investment banks and policyholders on legal, regulatory and commercial issues including insurance registrations, distribution channels, fund raising, and claim filing.
